products.name: Tidylane
products.tagline: Calm inbox triage for busy founders
products.description: Tidylane reads your inbox each morning and sorts it into reply now, read later and archive, so you start the day with ten emails instead of a hundred. It learns from what you open and never sends anything on its own.
highlights: Sorts your inbox before you wake up
Never sends email on its own

faqs.a: It reads subject lines and senders to sort messages. Nothing is stored after sorting.

products.name: Quillmate
products.tagline: Write release notes straight from your commits
products.description: Connect a repo and Quillmate turns merged pull requests into readable release notes, grouped into new, improved and fixed. Edit the draft, then publish it to your changelog or copy it as Markdown.

products.name: Ledgerleaf
products.tagline: Bookkeeping that sorts itself out
products.description: Ledgerleaf connects to your business bank account and sorts every transaction into the right category. At month end you get a profit and loss report you can hand to your accountant.

products.name: Pixelfern
products.tagline: Turn rough sketches into clean UI mockups
products.description: Snap a photo of a whiteboard sketch and Pixelfern turns it into a tidy mockup with real buttons, inputs and spacing. Export to PNG or keep editing in the browser.
highlights: Export to PNG or keep editing

faqs.a: PNG images today, with Figma export coming soon.

products.name: Signalbox
products.tagline: Uptime alerts that only ping you when it matters
products.description: Signalbox checks your site and API every minute from five regions. It only alerts you when a problem lasts, so a single slow request doesn't wake you up at 3 am.

products.name: Brightloop
products.tagline: Weekly product analytics in plain English
products.description: Brightloop connects to your analytics and sends a short weekly email that says what changed and why, in plain sentences. No dashboards to dig through.

products.name: Mapleform
products.tagline: Forms that feel like a friendly chat
products.description: Mapleform asks one question at a time, like a friendly chat, which keeps people answering. Responses land in a spreadsheet, Slack or your CRM.

products.name: Nookdesk
products.tagline: A focus timer that lives in your Mac menu bar
products.description: Nookdesk sits in your Mac menu bar and runs focus sessions with gentle breaks. It can mute notifications while you work and shows a simple weekly streak.

products.name: Cobaltcast
products.tagline: Plan a month of social posts in ten minutes
products.description: Write once and Cobaltcast drafts posts for each network, spreads them over the month and publishes on time. See everything on one calendar.

products.name: Driftnote
products.tagline: Voice memos that turn into tidy notes
products.description: Record a voice memo on your Mac and Driftnote turns it into clean notes with a title, key points and to-dos. Everything stays on your device.

products.name: Ferrypay
products.tagline: Invoices with payment links built in
products.description: Send an invoice with a pay button built in. Ferrypay reminds late clients for you and marks invoices paid the moment money arrives.

products.name: Lumenkit
products.tagline: Accessible color palettes from one brand color
products.description: Pick one brand color and Lumenkit builds a full palette that passes contrast checks, with light and dark versions ready to paste into your CSS.

products.name: Queuebird
products.tagline: A waitlist page with referrals built in
products.description: Launch a waitlist page in minutes. Queuebird gives every sign-up a referral link, so people move up the list by inviting friends.

products.name: Stackpine
products.tagline: See your API costs per customer
products.description: Stackpine tags every API call with the customer who made it, so you can see which accounts cost you the most and price your plans with confidence.

products.name: Hearthly
products.tagline: Shared calendars for small teams
products.description: Hearthly gives small teams one shared calendar for time off, launches and on-call, with a simple view of who's around this week.

products.name: Orbitgram
products.tagline: Track what people say about your product
products.description: Orbitgram watches social sites and forums for mentions of your product and sends a daily digest, so you can reply while the conversation is fresh.

products.name: Snapframe
products.tagline: Clean screenshots of your app in one click
products.description: Snapframe captures any window on your Mac and places it on a clean background with a soft shadow, ready for your landing page or a tweet.

products.name: Coinjar
products.tagline: Envelope budgeting for couples
products.description: Coinjar splits your shared money into envelopes like rent, food and fun, and shows both of you what's left in each one.

products.name: Promptshelf
products.tagline: Save and share your best AI prompts
products.description: Keep your best AI prompts in one place, add variables, and share collections with your team or the whole internet.

products.name: Echoleaf
products.tagline: Turn blog posts into short podcast episodes
products.description: Paste a blog post link and Echoleaf turns it into a short, natural-sounding podcast episode with its own feed.
